mechanism: In both SF matching collectors, the seed already occupies its distance-code slot. For another source of that code, skip matching when its cap cannot exceed seed length or its byte at seed length differs. Original insertion order, capacity, distinct codes and all retained quality choices remain unchanged.
difference_from_old_work: R19 shared-prefix work transferred a base cache and paid cache lookup costs. This uses only the already-live seed token and one tail byte; no new cache, hash structure, search budget or quality acceptance rule. New609 measured matching cost provides the opportunity.
